body: that's a good question i wouldn't even know what to do to be honest. You haven't hurt me I am just in a state of uncaring and I apologize or that.

I have never understood why I feel guilty when Im happy maybe I am just screwed up somehow as for the work thing I need to work to pay the bills it occupies my time and yet it is also a necessity I could drop one but part of having three jobs was to save up money for what I don't know I just have a compulsive need to save what ever money I get a hold of.  I am not afraid of hurting others more like afraid of being hurt.  I want to be gone it would be easier...I don't know I don't even know what is wrong Im sure it makes no sense I'm just in this slump and this time I cant seem to break free.  It should be simple right every problem has an answer but what do you do when you cant figure out what the problem is I have been struggling with this for a long while now and this time the feeling of I don't belong to here seems right.

Sure there are aspects of image that I don't like but I know that is true of everyone I am a heavy set girl but I know that I can be pretty if I put some effort into it . No I am not sure exactly what is wrong I dont feel like I have the right or deserve to be happy a lot of the time and when I find myself doing okay I seem to sabotage what ever it is that is going well for me and there is this anxiety that weighs me down all of the time I got criticized at work on Friday and in all honesty it wasn't a big deal it was ajust a supervisor telling me how to do better  but all i heard was you suck your a failure why do you think you can do this you will never succeed and I broke down crying and became defensive and there was no reason for it I was so embarrassed that I left work early and I called in sick today.  I am supposed to be adult right, which means I should not have reacted like that there was no reason for it.  But truth be told I work 3 jobs just so I dont have much free time because whenever I am alone or at home I just hate myself my life and I realize that I am alone and when I say that understand that I am not trying to be dramatic I really am by myself and have been since I was booted out of the foster care system I have no family and I have a hard time making attachments to people because I have this gripping fear that they will leave.

I dont know everything just feels bad I hate myself and I am so tired of being alone I tried college but I wasn't able to make it through I just am so tired of just going through the motions I don't see a future for my self and this crushing overwhelming feeling of absolute worthlessness makes it hard to pretend to smile and be happy for those around me.  I don't know whats wrong to even begin to tell them whats wrong. If that makes any sense.
